//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the TEXTAREA component — the multi-line form field `.pa-textarea` (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.textarea/1`, svelte `forms/Textarea.svelte`). SCOPE = the BARE `<textarea class="pa-textarea ...">value</textarea>` both wrappers emit — a self-contained, flat control. CRITICAL divergence from pa-input/pa-select: core defines NO `pa-textarea--success|warning|error` validation-border class (confirmed: the only `.pa-textarea--*` selectors in dist/css/main.css are the 4 sizes + color-1..9). Textarea errors surface through a surrounding `pa-form-group--error` / `pa-form-help--error`, not a border modifier (snippets/forms.html:109-113, 546-555). Both wrappers agree and emit NO state class for textarea — keen's `textarea_classes` drops `validation`, svelte's NOTE comment says the state drives aria-invalid only. The `value` is the ELEMENT'S TEXT CONTENT (<textarea>value</textarea>), not a `value` attribute. The blessed empty shape (no value) is `<textarea class="pa-textarea"></textarea>`. disabled/readonly/required/placeholder/name/id are NATIVE attrs, not classes. ROWS: svelte hardcodes a `rows={4}` default that is ALWAYS emitted; keen routes `rows` through `@rest` so it only appears when supplied — so `rows` is NOT a modeled feature here and goldens carry no `rows`, with svelte's phantom-default `rows="4"` fixed in the wrapper (see fix note). Sibling controls pa-input/pa-select and the field-wrapper chrome (pa-form-group / label / pa-form-help) are DIFFERENT components, out of scope + prose-deferred. See input.json for the bare-control model.

propsVocabulary.size: xs|sm|lg|xl — height/padding/font size variant (default is the unmodified md textarea). Shared scale with pa-input/pa-select; pa-textarea--{size} sets both height and min-height so it grows but can't collapse.
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme colour slot — pa-textarea--color-N (paints the border with --pc-color-N). The ONLY colour axis; textarea has no validation-state border.
propsVocabulary.value: textarea VALUE — rendered as the element's text content, not an attribute. Emitted only when supplied.
propsVocabulary.name: native name attribute
propsVocabulary.id: native id attribute (hand-set — the normalizer keeps real ids, only strips framework-generated ones)
propsVocabulary.disabled: native boolean attribute (there is NO pa-textarea--disabled class)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the bare `<textarea class="pa-textarea ...">value</textarea>` from snippets/forms.html. `value` is the text content, present ONLY in scenarios that set it (empty shape is `<textarea ...></textarea>`). No `rows` attribute appears (see the top note — svelte's always-on default is fixed, keen routes it via rest). There is NO validation-state class for textarea — state scenarios are intentionally absent. Native boolean attrs (disabled/readonly/required) are canonicalized to bare presence by the normalizer. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The ONLY `.pa-textarea--*` selectors are the 4 sizes + color-1..9 — there is intentionally NO success/warning/error (the pa-input/pa-select validation borders do NOT exist for textarea). `produces: null` = a native HTML attribute (placeholder/name/id) or the text-content value or a native boolean attr (disabled/readonly/required), NOT a pa-textarea class.

value.note: textarea text content — emitted only when supplied

disabled.note: native boolean attribute — there is NO pa-textarea--disabled class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: No `pa-textarea__*` element classes exist in main.css, so there is nothing to bucket for the strict element-coverage check. This records the field-wrapper chrome that is SEPARATE components (not the pa-textarea block) and intentionally out of this bare-control slice — prose only. They carry no `pa-textarea` prefix so they don't affect the axis-1 element sweep.
deferred.note-form-group: pa-form-group / --success|warning|error|horizontal|required — the field WRAPPER (form-layout component). For TEXTAREA this is where a validation state is painted, since the control itself has no --error border. Modeled by the form-group slice.
deferred.note-form-help: pa-form-help / --error|success|warning|color-N — help/validation caption below the textarea. Modeled by the form-help slice.
deferred.note-no-state-class: There is deliberately NO pa-textarea--success/--warning/--error in core; a validation state lives on the surrounding group/help, not on the control.
